description: Assigns a label with the name sl to history sn. During plotting, this name will appear instead of the default name. If you wish to use the original name again, assign an empty string ('').
notes: On 6.0 this is the only history labelling command (history label does not exist there).
The 7.0/9.0 manuals dropped this page in favour of history label, but the command remains live on 7.00 and 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the six PFC consoles (2D/3D x 6.00/7.00/9.8) (state grade): history name '1' label ... accepted on all six and the label shows in the history list Label column; history label is rejected on 6.00.
